Coolicons drawn as strokes with regular corners: 1,258 icons, the variant

The left pull-down lists the brands; each one opens its own page with its own catalog.

Pick an icon and it fills the preview tab. Weight, size and surface repaint it as you press, without touching the file.

Icons 2.3 · app.offline.icons · 606 Lineicons and 1,258 Coolicons, both MIT. The paid icons sold on either vendor's site are neither included nor copied.
